#!/bin/sh
set -e

install -m 600 "$TMPKEY" "$CERTDIR/tls.key"
install -m 644 "$TMPCRT" "$CERTDIR/tls.crt"
rm -f "$TMPKEY" "$TMPCRT"

systemctl reload nginx
EOF
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh

commands.command:
sudo tee /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
CERTDIR=/etc/pki/tls/rotating
TMPKEY="$CERTDIR/tls.key.new"
TMPCRT="$CERTDIR/tls.crt.new"
NODEIP="$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')"

openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout "$TMPKEY" -out "$TMPCRT" \
  -days 1 -subj "/CN=node1.cert-rotation.local" \
  -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1.cert-rotation.local,IP:${NODEIP:-127.0.0.1}"

install -m 600 "$TMPKEY" "$CERTDIR/tls.key"
install -m 644 "$TMPCRT" "$CERTDIR/tls.crt"
rm -f "$TMPKEY" "$TMPCRT"

systemctl reload nginx
logger -t renew-cert "certificate renewed, serial=$(openssl x509 -in $CERTDIR/tls.crt -noout -serial)"
EOF
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh
sudo bash -n /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh 2>&1 || sudo sh -n /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh
echo OK
